message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters. Below the title is the text "18-24 JANUARI 2016". In the upper left, a green and yellow logo sits above the text "INVESTIGASI: JEJARING TKI ILEGAL". Further down, on the left, it says "Jakarta, 14 Januari 2016".

The central image shows an asphalt road with a dashed white line. In the background, only the lower legs and feet of a person are visible. In the foreground, a person wearing a white shirt, dark trousers, and a black helmet stands with their back to the viewer. To their right, another person wearing a dark vest over a light blue shirt and a black cap points a dark handgun at the first person. Behind them is a dark SUV with a chrome grille and headlights. Two motorcycles are parked in the foreground, partially obscuring the lower half of the scene. The image has a red border on the left side. The bottom right corner contains a price of "RP 39.500", a website, a barcode, and serial numbers.
